title: BAM Alignment to CP018802 for Submission to GenBank
author: Gregory P Harhay
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.862hzge

steps.title: Install required software
steps.instruction: Ensure Geneious 11.1.5 (or an alternative mapper such as BowTie2) and samtools version 1.9 are installed and accessible; samtools can be obtained from https://htslib.org/.

steps.title: Map libraries to reference
steps.instruction: Map each of the nine PacBio CCS libraries (L.17494, L.17495, L.17836, L.18256_1, L.18256_2, L.18257, L.19770, L.19771, L.19981) to the reference CP018802 using Geneious Assembler with the settings: Medium Sensitivity/Fast, iterate up to 5 times, and map multiple best‑matched reads randomly. Export each resulting alignment as a SAM file.

substeps.instruction: Open Geneious (or BowTie2) and load reference CP018802.
Load a library (e.g., L.17494) and run the Assembler with the specified parameters.
When the alignment finishes, export the alignment to a SAM file named <library>_GeneMap_CP018802.sam.

steps.title: Add read group metadata to SAM
steps.instruction: For each SAM file, use samtools addreplacerg to replace the read‑group header with the correct library (LB) and sample (SM) identifiers, then delete any original @RG line so the header matches the example format.

substeps.instruction: Run: samtools addreplacerg -r ID:LB:<library> -r SM:63250 -m overwrite_all -o <library>_GeneMap_CP018802_RG.sam <library>_GeneMap_CP018802.sam (e.g., for L.17494 use -r ID:LB:17494).
Open the resulting *_RG.sam file and verify that the header contains only:
Remove any original @RG header lines that do not follow this format and save the file.

steps.title: Merge SAMs into final BAM
steps.instruction: Combine all read‑group‑corrected SAM files into a single BAM file using samtools merge.

steps.title: Access final BAM file
steps.instruction: The merged BAM file (H_somni.L.101617.S.63250.bam) is available for download at https://trace.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/Traces/sra/sra.cgi?run=SRR8080935 and is named SRR8080935_CP018802.bam.
